nodes.description: Public total token supply declared in ERC20Basic and mutated by mint, burn and the VCTToken constructor.
mapping(address => uint256) token balances declared in BasicToken; credited and debited by transfer, transferFrom, burn, mint and the VCTToken constructor.
mapping(address => mapping(address => uint256)) allowances declared in StandardToken; written by approve and decremented by transferFrom.
Privileged owner address in Ownable; guards onlyOwner protected functions.
Boolean flag in MintableToken that disables further minting through the canMint modifier.
Public token name string in VCTToken, set once in the constructor.
Public token symbol string in VCTToken, set once in the constructor.
Public uint8 decimals fixed to 18 in VCTToken, used as the exponent scaling the initial supply.
BasicToken.transfer: validates _to and balances, applies SafeMath sub/add and emits Transfer.
BasicToken.balanceOf: view function returning balances[_owner].
StandardToken.transferFrom: spends the caller allowance, moves balances and decrements allowed.
StandardToken.approve: sets allowed[msg.sender][_spender] = _amount with no zero-allowance reset.
StandardToken.allowance: view function returning the remaining allowance.
BurnableToken.burn: destroys _value tokens of msg.sender and reduces totalSupply.
Ownable.transferOwnership: onlyOwner function that reassigns the owner address.
MintableToken.mint: onlyOwner and canMint guarded supply increase crediting _to.
MintableToken.finishMinting: onlyOwner and canMint guarded function that sets mintingFinished.
VCTToken.multiSend: loops over dests/values arrays and calls transfer for every pair without a size cap.
VCTToken.getTokenDetail: view function returning name, symbol and totalSupply.
VCTToken payable fallback that unconditionally reverts on received ether.
VCTToken constructor: computes totalSupply = initialSupply * 10 ** decimals, stores name/symbol and credits msg.sender.
Ownable constructor: sets owner = msg.sender, establishing the privileged role.
SafeMath.add: overflow-checked addition used by transfer, transferFrom and mint.
SafeMath.sub: underflow-checked subtraction used by transfer, transferFrom and burn.
SafeMath.mul: overflow-checked multiplication helper that is not used for the constructor scaling.
SafeMath.div: division helper of the SafeMath library.
msg.sender: caller-controlled address used as balance owner, allowance owner, spender, initial holder and contract owner.
Unchecked arithmetic initialSupply * 10 ** uint256(decimals) in the VCTToken constructor, executed without SafeMath.
allowance is overwritten directly by approve, enabling the classic approve/transferFrom front-running race.
multiSend iterates over caller-supplied arrays with no length bound, risking out-of-gas and blocking behaviour.
Parameter _to of BasicToken.transfer, the destination address.
Parameter _amount of BasicToken.transfer, the number of tokens moved.
Parameter _owner of BasicToken.balanceOf, the queried account.
Parameter _from of StandardToken.transferFrom, the debited account.
Parameter _spender of approve/allowance, the account granted or queried for an allowance.
Parameter _value of BurnableToken.burn, the amount destroyed.
Parameter newOwner of Ownable.transferOwnership, the replacement owner address.
Parameter _amount of MintableToken.mint, the supply increase credited to _to.
Parameter dests of VCTToken.multiSend, caller-supplied array of recipient addresses.
Parameter values of VCTToken.multiSend, caller-supplied array of token amounts.
Parameter initialSupply of the VCTToken constructor, multiplied by 10**decimals without SafeMath.
Parameter tokenName of the VCTToken constructor assigned to name.
Parameter tokenSymbol of the VCTToken constructor assigned to symbol.
Loop counter i in VCTToken.multiSend driving the while (i < dests.length) loop.

edges.reason: msg.sender is the account whose balance is checked and debited inside transfer.
msg.sender is the spender whose allowance is read and decremented in transferFrom.
msg.sender is the allowance owner written by approve.
msg.sender balance is reduced by burn.
Ownable constructor assigns the privileged owner role directly from msg.sender.
VCTToken constructor mints the entire initial supply to msg.sender.
_to carries the destination address into transfer.
_amount carries the transferred quantity into transfer.
_owner selects the balance mapping slot read by balanceOf.
_from selects the debited account in transferFrom.
_spender selects the allowance slot written by approve.
_spender selects the allowance slot read by allowance.
_value carries the amount destroyed by burn.
newOwner carries the replacement privileged address into transferOwnership.
_amount carries the minted quantity into mint.
dests supplies the recipient array iterated by multiSend.
values supplies the amount array iterated by multiSend.
initialSupply feeds the unchecked multiplication 10 ** decimals in the constructor.
tokenName is assigned to the name state variable.
tokenSymbol is assigned to the symbol state variable.
Local counter i drives the while loop of multiSend.
transfer reads and rewrites the balances mapping for sender and recipient.
transfer routes recipient credit through SafeMath.add to block overflow.
transfer routes sender debit through SafeMath.sub to block underflow.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping.
transferFrom debits _from and credits _to in balances.
transferFrom reads and reduces the allowed allowance matrix.
transferFrom uses SafeMath.sub for both the balance and the allowance decrement.
approve writes the allowed mapping.
approve overwrites any existing non-zero allowance, enabling the allowance race.
allowance reads the allowed mapping.
burn decrements balances[msg.sender].
burn decrements totalSupply.
burn uses SafeMath.sub on the sender balance and the total supply.
transferOwnership rewrites the privileged owner address.
onlyOwner modifier verifies msg.sender against owner before transferOwnership executes.
onlyOwner modifier gates mint on the stored owner.
onlyOwner modifier gates finishMinting on the stored owner.
mint increases totalSupply.
mint credits balances[_to].
mint uses SafeMath.add for both supply and balance increases.
canMint modifier reads mintingFinished to authorise minting.
canMint modifier reads mintingFinished to authorise finishMinting.
finishMinting irreversibly sets mintingFinished to true.
multiSend loops calling the internal transfer function for each array pair.
multiSend loop is bounded only by caller-supplied array lengths, producing an unbounded gas cost.
Constructor assigns the computed initial supply to totalSupply.
Constructor assigns the whole supply to balances[msg.sender].
Constructor performs initialSupply * 10 ** decimals with raw arithmetic instead of SafeMath.
Constructor assigns the name state variable.
Constructor assigns the symbol state variable.
Constructor reads decimals to build the 10 ** decimals scaling factor.
getTokenDetail returns name.
getTokenDetail returns symbol.
getTokenDetail returns totalSupply.
Ownable constructor writes the owner state variable.

normalization_plan.reason: _to is only meaningful as the destination argument of transfer, so it collapses into that function node.
_amount is only used inside transfer for the balance checks and SafeMath operations.
_owner solely indexes balances within the view function balanceOf.
_from is the debited account handled entirely inside transferFrom.
_spender identifies the allowance slot written by approve.
_value is the destroyed quantity processed only by burn.
newOwner is the replacement privileged address consumed by transferOwnership.
_amount is the credited quantity handled only by the onlyOwner mint function.
dests is the recipient array iterated exclusively by multiSend.
values is the amount array iterated exclusively by multiSend.
initialSupply is the operand of the unchecked multiplication in the VCTToken constructor.
tokenName is only assigned to the name state variable by the constructor.
tokenSymbol is only assigned to the symbol state variable by the constructor.
Loop counter i exists only to drive the while loop inside multiSend.
